description: See how many Acoustic Sound Panels to plan for in a room and what they cost today. Give the room's length, width and ceiling height in feet and what the room is used for. Returns a starting panel size and count, the estimated echo before and after, exact current prices from the store when they are available, the shipping statement that applies, and a link to the product page. Panels are priced as Burch Fabrics Prime Time, and other fabrics show their own exact prices on the product page.

ceiling_height_ft.description: Ceiling height in feet, 6 to 30. Decimals are fine.

length_ft.description: Room length in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

room_use.description: What the room is used for.

width_ft.description: Room width in feet, 4 to 400. Decimals are fine.

name: asp_recommend_panels
title: Recommend panels for a room
